Dear Maxime Maucler,
thank you for contacting Siemens eMobility Technical Support.
Our Technical Support team will create an official case in our ticketing system shortly and will inform you accordingly through email, including the official  case number of the incident.
Please wait till you get the offical reply from us and do not reply to this email, since it will not be monitored
If you are reporting an incident from  charger operating  at a Siemens location, you will not be notified futher. The incident will be forwarded to the Siemens location manager.
The reported incident is for charger type:
SiCharge D
Serial number:
P6 170000684 / sM6jEA
Thank you
eMobility Technical Support Team

Bitte warten Sie auf die offizielle Ticket Antwort und antworten Sie nicht auf diese E-Mail. Diese Mailbox wird nicht überwacht.

additional_info.body:
Hello Team,
I trust this email finds you in good health. We have received a technical support request from in your region regarding the following product:
Product:
Sicharge D - Charging Center
Main Asset:
MP / P6 170000684
Charger ID/Serial No.:
sM6jEA
Problem Description: The HMI is defective at the center
We found that an HMI replacement was performed on this charger due to delamination, as mentioned in the previous ticket. Could you please confirm if the HMI was working fine after installation/replacement, or if it had a defect at that time?
Upon reviewing our asset database, we found that the product is no longer under warranty since 09/08/2024, as a result, we are transferring the case to the regional queue.
Kindly communicate with the customer and provide the necessary service support and/or offer. We have already informed the customer that a regional representative will be in touch shortly.
